name: hud_ui_panel_get_text_rect
description: HudUiPanel::GetTextRect returns the panel origin expanded by cached text width and queried text height, rebuilding dirty metrics first.
known_limits: No VC byte target covers 0x4bb740 yet; tier S remains open for a later HUD panel text-metrics source-file pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly at 0x4bb740 validates HudUiElement::GetTextRect(outRect), optional dirty RebuildTextRect dispatch through vtable slot 36 (+0x90), outRect->right = outRect->left + textWidthPx, and outRect->bottom = outRect->top + HudUiPanel::QueryTextHeight().
The native panel query-text-height smoke verifies GetTextRect with cached metrics, including origin left/top and right/bottom expansion by text width and queried height.
